steps.title: Analyze existing Simple Clicker structure and prepare 3D upgrade path
steps.description: Evaluate current XML layout, styles, and MainActivity patterns to replace flat UI counter displays with real-time interactive 3D graphics rendering.

steps.title: Clean up unauthorized external web-server dependencies
steps.description: Purge non-essential libraries such as nanohttpd to enforce the standard SDK-only compilation rules of the build system.

steps.title: Define 3D coordinate geometry vertex maps in ThreeDObjectView
steps.description: Create a fully custom coordinate map with 8 standard 3D vertices representing the corners of a spatial cube model.

steps.title: Set up 3D face mappings for the 6 polygons
steps.description: Create indexed point paths representing the individual faces of our custom 3D tally cube, aligning textures and coordinates to face upright when fronting the camera.

steps.title: Implement standard trigonometric 3D rotation equations
steps.description: Write standard mathematical transformations to rotate vertices around the spatial Pitch (X) and Yaw (Y) axes based on automatic triggers or gesture dynamics.

steps.title: Implement Painter's algorithm face depth sorting
steps.description: Build sorting logic to calculate average Z-depth of each face and sort them back-to-front dynamically for accurate overlaps without visual glitches.

steps.title: Incorporate real-time directional lighting calculations
steps.description: Calculate dynamic 3D surface normals to establish real-time face light shading based on current coordinate rotation angles.

steps.title: Set up 3D perspective projection onto the 2D Viewport canvas
steps.description: Utilize Matrix.setPolyToPoly in conjunction with perspective division to translate 3D coordinates onto flat screens smoothly.

steps.title: Implement drag-to-rotate interaction physics
steps.description: Capture drag gestures on the canvas to update rotation angles dynamically, adding custom friction momentum upon finger release.

steps.title: Implement spring physics squeeze scale on tap
steps.description: Create a satisfying physical spring-mass simulation that visually depresses and rebounds the 3D cube when a click is executed.

steps.title: Integrate responsive state coloring inside ThreeDObjectView
steps.description: Draw crisp tally values directly on the 3D cube face and update the base canvas palette when high scores or negative values are reached.

steps.title: Update activity_main.xml layout with the custom 3D Viewport
steps.description: Replace static typography with the custom ThreeDObjectView layout block, sizing coordinates and padding structures cleanly.

steps.title: Refactor MainActivity logic to support the interactive 3D canvas
steps.description: Link touch listeners, count callbacks, high score updates, and vibration triggers perfectly between MainActivity controller and ThreeDObjectView.

steps.title: Verify application attributes, package labels, and platform orientation
steps.description: Adjust android:label values in the manifest to match Simple Clicker 3D, and secure proper XML namespaces.

steps.title: Building Simple Clicker 3D
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to compile Java structures, apply resources, and assemble the final application package.
